data: Based on the caption and the information provided in Figure 3, which model training methods are compared in this ablation study?

The caption states that the ablation study compares models trained with reduced explicit negative examples at both token-level and construction-level. The legend indicates four different training methods: LSTM-LM, margin (token), margin (token) w/o negative examples on target verbs, and margin (token) w/o negative examples on a construction. These correspond to the four colored bars in the graphs. Therefore, the comparison includes these four training methods.
